title: Seller Listing Coverage and Listing Extensions under Real Estate Service Contracts
content:
## Seller listing coverage

Seller listing coverage under a Real Estate Service Contracts listing order runs from the order date through the listing coverage end date, and ends earlier when the sale closes or the order is cancelled.

It covers the seller for failures of items the plan covers, limited to the plan's per-item seller limit for each item and the plan's total seller limit, with heating, cooling and ductwork covered only when the plan's seller heating-and-cooling coverage is Yes. Roof leaks and the rekey benefit are never part of seller coverage.

## Listing extensions

A listing extension is granted only when all three of the following hold, each read from the system record of the listing order concerned before the extension is granted:

1. **Status.** The order is in status listing coverage.
2. **Timing.** The extension is requested no later than the plan's seller coverage period, in calendar days, after the order is placed, counting from the day after the order date with the boundary day included.
3. **Count.** The order's listing extension count is below the plan's maximum number of listing extensions.

An extension adds the plan's listing extension days, in calendar days, to the listing coverage end date.

### The timing condition counted out

The clock starts from the order being placed, as shown by the order date on the record. Day 1 is the day after the order date. On a plan whose seller coverage period is 180 days (hypothetical order):

| Day on which the extension is requested, counted from the day after the order date | Timing condition |
|---|---|
| day 179 | met |
| day 180 (the boundary day) | met |
| day 181 | not met |

### Conditions in combination

Each condition is required; failing any one of them means no extension is granted.

| In listing coverage | Requested by the boundary day | Extension count below the maximum | Result under these conditions |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | all three conditions met |
| no | any | any | no extension |
| any | no | any | no extension |
| any | any | no | no extension |

## End of the listing period without a closing

When the listing coverage end date passes without a closing, the order moves to listing expired on the following day, the plan invoice is credited in full, and any listing-period service is billed as a failed-sale charge under the failed-sale charge rules. A seller whose listing expired may have the agent place a new order.
